title: H100 kernel Roofline plot (log–log memory vs compute ceiling)
what: moe_grouped_gemm achieves 488 TFLOP/s (49.3% of 989 TFLOP/s ceiling) while gemm_fp16_tile hits 792 TFLOP/s (80.1%); ridge point 295 FLOP/byte

reader_questions.question: What throughput and roof efficiency does moe_grouped_gemm achieve?
reader_questions.expected: 488 TFLOP/s (49.3% of the 989 TFLOP/s compute roof).

reader_questions.question: At what arithmetic intensity does the H100 transition from memory-bound to compute-bound?
reader_questions.expected: At the ridge point of ~295 FLOP/byte.

reader_questions.question: Which kernels are near the memory bandwidth ceiling?
reader_questions.expected: rmsnorm_v1, softmax_fused, rope_apply, and flash_attn_fwd sit close to the 3.35 TB/s memory roof.
